description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You attempt to reshape another creature’s memories. Roll Persuade vs Riddle against a creature within short range. If you are in combat with the creature, its roll is favored.

On a win, the creature's speed, actions and reactions are reduced to 0 and it becomes unaware of its surroundings, though it can still hear you. If it takes any damage or is targeted by another spell, this spell ends, and none of its memories are modified.

While this spell lasts, you can alter the target’s memory of an event it experienced within the last 24 hours that lasted no more than 10 minutes. You can erase the memory entirely, allow it to be recalled with perfect clarity and detail, modify its details, or replace it with a memory of a different event.

You must speak to the target to describe the altered memory, and it must be able to understand you for the changes to take hold. The target’s mind fills in any gaps in your description. If the spell ends before you finish describing the memory, the creature’s memory is unchanged. Otherwise, the modified memory takes hold when the spell ends.

A modified memory doesn’t necessarily influence the creature’s behavior, especially if it conflicts with its nature, beliefs, or alignment. Illogical memories may be dismissed at the GM’s discretion.
name: Modify Memory
